statusAsOf: Status as of the example clock
codeHint: These synthetic codes illustrate fault records. They are not decoded manufacturer trouble codes or a mechanical diagnosis.
statusHint: The status is the source's report at the example clock. A reported resolved state does not confirm a repair or a cleared ECU fault. Viewing this record does not change a physical vehicle.
history: Related fault report and status history
historyHint: These records are the observations referenced by this fault. A fault report and a reported status change remain separate records.
noObservations: No related observation records are available in this selection.
